shots.title: Explore the security CLI
shots.output:
Usage: 0 [options] [command]

Open-source multi-model security research harness

Options:
  -V, --version                               output the version number
  -h, --help                                  display help for command

Commands:
  scan [options]                              Run autonomous pentest against a URL, web app, or MCP server
  resume [options] <scanId>                   Resume a previous scan from persisted state
  replay [options]                            Replay the last scan's attack chain as an animated terminal sequence
  history [options]                           Show past scan history from run-local SQLite databases
  findings [options]                          Browse and manage persisted findings
  secure [options] <repo>                     Find, reproduce, fix, and verify vulnerabilities in a repo; optionally open repair PRs
  review [options] <repo>                     Deep source code security review of a repository
  fix [options] <repo>                        Generate and optionally apply a fix for one reproduced finding
  audit [options] <package>                   Run a package security workflow (compatibility shortcut)
  doctor                                      Check local runtime prerequisites and suggest the next command
  dashboard|web [options]                     Run the local browser console and operations workspace
  tui|watch                                   Retired terminal UI; use 0 web for interactive work
  team                                        Provision opt-in local team workspace accounts
  orchestrate [options]                       Run the verification worker against queued cases
  db                                          Manage the local 0 database
  mcp-server [options]                        Expose selected target tools or managed workflows over MCP stdio
  workflow                                    Discover templates, inspect saved workflows, and execute a workflow
  sessions                                    Inspect and control sessions on the selected engine
  runs                                        Inspect workflow run history
  triage                                      Triage findings and manage false-positive memories
  eval [options]                              Run adversarial safety eval against an AI/LLM endpoint and produce a scorecard
  bench                                       Benchmark variants and gate regressions over the labeled corpus
  ingest [options] [path]                     Import kernel crash reports (KASAN, UBSAN, oops, syzkaller) into 0 findings
  kernel                                      Kernel security workflows
  disclose [options] [findingId]              Assemble GHSA-ready advisory drafts from persisted findings
  verify [options] [finding]                  Deterministically replay a finding's PoC steps and emit a verification_result JSON.
  exploit [options]                           Escalate a confirmed kernel memory-safety finding toward root in a VM (safe no-op without --climb).
  hunt [options]                              Hunt a bug class across a source tree, seeded by a proven fix. Emits leads to verify, not confirmed bugs.
  recency-hunt [options]                      Hunt recent kernel commits (linux-next) for security regressions. Emits leads to verify, not confirmed bugs.
  deep-review [options] <target>              Seedless deep security review of a source tree. Emits leads to verify, not confirmed bugs.
  lens-synth [options]                        Improve appsec detection coverage from curated missed findings
  memsafety [options] <source>                Fuzz a C/Rust source tree for memory-safety bugs and emit reproduced crashes.
  assumption-hunt [options] <source-root>     Find callers that violate a function's implied preconditions. Emits candidates to disprove, not confirmed bugs.
  specdrift                                   Private protocol/spec differential-hunting research commands
  protocol-check [options]                    Check an HTTP implementation against a spec excerpt for MUST-level violations.
  cve                                         CVE workflows: artifact lookup (`find`) and autonomous PoC adaptation (`adapt`).
  upgrade|update [options]                    Fetch and install the latest 0 binary (re-runs install.sh)
  deps                                        Scan and remediate project dependencies for known vulnerabilities
  h1                                          HackerOne hacker-API helpers (read-only)
  intel                                       Live vulnerability intelligence lookup helpers
  recon [options] <domain>                    Map a domain's attack surface: subdomains, endpoints, API docs, and MCP servers.
  console|chat [options]                      Run a headless chat prompt; interactive conversations use 0 web
  js-recon [options] <url>                    Mine live JavaScript for endpoints, API bases, and redacted secrets
  npm-discovery                               Dynamic bug discovery for npm packages; confirmed only on observed runtime impact.
  identity [options]                          Read-only security posture check of a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) tenant. Reads the Graph token from ZERO_GRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN; never accepts it as an argument.
  adgraph [options]                           Offline Active Directory attack-path analysis over BloodHound/SharpHound JSON on disk. Reads files only: never collects, authenticates, or touches the network.
  entragraph [options]                        Offline Microsoft Entra ID attack-path analysis over an AzureHound export on disk. Reads files only: never collects, authenticates, or touches the network.
  cloud                                       Read-only S3 and AWS credential probes
  xnu-fuzz                                    IOKit user-client fuzzer for macOS kernel (xnu) security research.
  research                                    Run target-specific research engines
  worker                                      Deploy and manage remote Zero engine workers
  radar [options]                             Score recent git commits for silent security-fix signals to prioritize review. Requires ZERO_JEV_FEATURES=radar.
  timeline [options] <scanId>                 Export a scan's event audit trail as a chronological, MITRE ATT&CK-tagged record.
  agent-assure [options]                      Test whether untrusted MCP content can trigger a prohibited agent action
  binary [options] <target> [passthrough...]  Analyze a compiled binary (delegates to the 0verse engine)
  plugin                                      Install, enable, inspect, and run Hackstore extensions
  theme                                       List, install, apply, export, and remove console colour themes
  evolve                                      Self-improvement: propose, evaluate, and promote new detection workers
  learning                                    Inspect and process evidence-backed workflow learning
  config                                      Inspect, export, and import console configuration (global and project layers)
  workbench                                   Set up and inspect the sandboxed execution workbench (no Docker)
  checks                                      Manage private, project-scoped local review checks. No cloud enrollment or credentials required.
  hackstore|hack                              Author extensions for Hackstore, the 0 extension store
  help [command]                              display help for command

shots.title: Connect security tools to your agent
shots.output:
Usage: 0 mcp-server [options]

Expose selected target tools or managed workflows over MCP stdio

Options:
  --target <target>            Target URL for this MCP session
  --scan-id <scanId>           Scan ID to associate persisted findings and
                               target updates with
  --backend <id>               Use a registered remote workflow engine; no
                               local execution fallback
  --backends-config <path>     Operator backend connection registry JSON file
  --engine-url <url>           Attach directly to a running trusted engine
  --engine-token-env <name>    Environment variable holding the attached engine
                               token
  --session <id>               Attach workflow runs to an existing session on
                               the selected engine
  --workflows                  Expose workflow discovery and run lifecycle
                               tools instead of live tools (default: false)
  --allow-apply                Permit explicit workflow apply requests inside
                               the authorized workspace (default: false)
  --workspace <path>           Absolute authorized local root for workflow
                               source assessments
  --db-path <path>             Path to SQLite database
  --timeout <ms>               Default tool timeout in milliseconds (default:
                               "30000")
  --scope <path>               Path to a 0 scope JSON file. Out-of-scope URLs
                               are refused by every target tool.
  --tools <names>              Comma-separated 0 MCP tools to expose (default:
                               live tools, or workflow tools with --workflows).
  --rate-limit <spec>          Per-host request rate-limit spec. Defaults to 5
                               rps when unset. An active --engagement-profile
                               caps this: the effective rate is the minimum of
                               the two, so the profile can only lower it.
  --allow-scanners             Disable generic-scanner suppression for scoped
                               engagements. (default: false)
  --engagement-profile <name>  Engagement hardening posture for authorized
                               enterprise work. 'standard' (default) is the
                               existing behaviour. 'conservative' applies the
                               quiet posture to this MCP session: no adaptive
                               WAF-evasion ladder, full jitter on the per-host
                               token bucket, and a 1 rps/host ceiling. The
                               profile can only ever make the session quieter —
                               the effective rate is the minimum of the profile
                               and --rate-limit. The applied posture is
                               recorded as an `engagement_posture_applied`
                               event on the scan so it can be handed to the
                               client as evidence. Lower precedence than the
                               scope file's `engagement` block and
                               ZERO_ENGAGEMENT_PROFILE.
  --no-waf-evasion             Disable the adaptive WAF-evasion ladder
                               (default: on). When a response classifies as
                               blocked, the engine normally retries with
                               encoding/casing/whitespace-mutated payload
                               variants, which escalates a routine WAF block
                               into a SOC incident. Detection and reporting of
                               the block are unaffected. Independent of
                               --engagement-profile; env form:
                               ZERO_WAF_EVASION=0.
  -h, --help                   display help for command
